skill.summary: This skill evaluates arithmetic expressions using the Unix `bc` calculator. It accepts full `bc` syntax (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, mod...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of bc-calc.
- Evaluates arithmetic expressions using the Unix `bc` calculator, supporting full `bc` syntax.
- Provides arbitrary-precision calculations and access to advanced functions (trigonometric, logarithmic, etc.) via the math library (enabled by default).
- Accepts expressions as command-line arguments or via standard input.
- Returns precise results or relevant `bc` error messages for invalid expressions.
